_meta.purpose: H2 Agent Simulation — synthetic edge-case set for the conversation_responder triage stall. Each case is a ConversationResponderInput (by-alias) + the correct triage decision/reason. Run _baseline_triage over the set for the BEFORE number, _optimized_triage (the live triage_inbound) for the AFTER number.
_meta.authority: GRAND-NARRATIVE-PLAN.md §5-1 H2 + H5 (anti-overfit holdout); DECISIONS.md D23 (Tier-1 #5), D25 (learning loop, learning loop), D32 (observability), D5 (models). D25, D37.
_meta.honesty_note: These are hand-authored synthetic cases, not real creator data (D10). expected_decision/expected_reason_tag are the ground truth the triage is measured against. The 'expected_decision' for a creator who is negotiating is ALWAYS escalate — that is the correct outcome per runtime.Escalation + D27.
_meta.split_note: Each case carries a `split`: "train" or "holdout" (default train). The TRAIN cases are the patterns the `_optimized_triage` rules were authored against. The HOLDOUT slice (split=holdout) was carved out AFTER the rules were written and was NOT used to design them — it measures GENERALIZATION, not memorization. The optimized triage does WELL but NOT perfectly on the holdout: its rate-signal rule keys on the STRUCTURED `extracted.proposed_rate_usd` field, so holdout cases where the negotiation intent is real but the structured field is absent/misleading (obfuscated 'comp', rate only in free text the extractor missed, mid-thread rate, sarcasm) legitimately defeat it. Those misses are the HONEST finding — we did NOT add rules to catch them (that would defeat the holdout). The follower-count bait (a number that is NOT a rate) is the false-positive control: the optimized triage must NOT escalate it.

cases.note: HOLDOUT MISS (expected). Classifier rounded to interested; the creator obliquely raises money ('discuss the comp / what's the budget') but names NO number, so the extractor left proposed_rate_usd null. This IS a negotiation, but the optimized rate-signal rule keys on the STRUCTURED field — it has no number to read, so it routes to respond. The honest miss: the rule generalizes to extracted rates, not to obfuscated money-talk. We deliberately do NOT add a free-text rule to catch it (that would defeat the holdout).
